content_sections.heading: SAI High Performance Coach Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.sports_authority_of_india_sai_new_delhi_: Level-13 Rs. 123100-215900 (Last Pay Drawn Minus Pension)

Diploma in coaching from SAI NS NIS Patiala or equivalent, or participation in Olympics/Paralympics/Asian Games/World Championship with certificate course in coaching, or Dronacharya Awardee, and analogous post or 5 years regular service in Level-12.
Maximum 64 years (as on opening date for submission of applications)

content_sections.heading: SAI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. A-12/8/2026-66 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download SAI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma in coaching from SAI NS NIS, Patiala or equivalent; Participation in Olympics/Paralympics/Asian Games/World Championship with certificate course in coaching; Dronacharya Awardee Experience: Officers who have worked under Central/State Governments/UT Administrations in analogous post or with regular service of 05 years in Level-12 (Rs. 78800-209200). Age limit: Maximum 64 years (as on opening date for submission of applications) Other conditions: Candidate will be required to attend office on regular basis and would not take up any other assignment during contract period Will abide by CCS (Conduct) Rules 1964 Services can be discontinued after giving 15 days notice if performance is not found satisfactory Desirable: 5 years of coaching experience in relevant sports from any government/recognized institute/private organization

content_sections.heading: SAI High Performance Coach Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be required to: Attend office on a regular basis and not take up any other assignment during the contract period. Maintain office decorum and discipline. Handle confidential information crucial to the operation of SAI, including coaching data, performance analysis, psychological testing and training data of athletes, business and financial information, business methods and practices, technology and technological strategies, marketing strategies, trade secrets, and other confidential information.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Period of 01 year or till the age of 64 years whichever is earlier Can be utilized by any Scheme/project funded by Government of India along with SAI for a period of one year

rows.event: Closing date for submission of online application

content_sections.heading: How Will SAI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on relevant experience and job description Interview of eligible candidates Candidates fulfilling eligibility criteria will be called for interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Aadhar Card/10th class mark sheet/12th class mark sheet Certificates of essential educational qualifications and experience Scanned copy of passport size color photograph and signature No Objection Certificate from current employer Latest Last Pay Drawn Certificate Pension Pay Order

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAI Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only online through the link https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs. Upload self-attested copies of Aadhar card/10th class mark sheet/12th class mark sheet. Upload certificates of essential educational qualifications and experience. Upload scanned copy of passport size color photograph and signature. Upload scanned copy of No Objection Certificate from present employer if working in Central/State/Autonomous Organization. Upload latest last pay drawn certificate and Pension Pay Order. Apply on or before 1 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The maximum tenure for the contractual post is till the age of 65 years
